prompts.title: 爆炸的品客薯片罐广告提示
prompts.description: 一个用于 Nano Banana Pro（通过 Gemini 应用）的提示，用于生成一张超逼真的电影广告摄影作品：一个倾斜的“Pringler – Fire Chili Flow”薯片罐，展示辛辣薯片向上爆裂的动态瞬间，伴随着飞散的辣椒粉和烟雾。
prompts.content: Ultra-realistic cinematic snack advertising photography of a tilted “Pringler – Fire Chili Flow” potato chips can bursting with spicy chips. The cylindrical can is angled diagonally in mid-air above a dark surface while fiery red-orange chips explode upward from the opening in dynamic motion. Fine chili powder and seasoning particles scatter through the air, creating a dramatic spice explosion. Wisps of hot smoky vapor rise around the chips to emphasize the intense chili flavor.

prompts.title: Sadie Sink 的逼真健身提示
prompts.description: 为 Gemini Nano Banana Pro 准备的两个独立且高度详细的提示，用于生成 Sadie Sink 身着运动服的超逼真图像，重点突出自然、真实、未经编辑的生活美学，并包含特定的光线和服装细节。
prompts.content:
Image 1 Prompt:
A high-resolution, candid medium shot of a young woman with wavy, auburn hair and light freckles, captured in a warm-toned indoor setting. She is looking downward with a focused expression while adjusting the waistband of her light khaki cargo pants. She wears a grey heathered athletic top featuring black trim and "NYATHLETICS" text on the band. The lighting is soft and cinematic, highlighting natural skin textures and a realistic, soft midsection. The background is slightly blurred, showing a modern interior with muted cream walls and a glimpse of an air conditioning unit, creating an authentic, unedited lifestyle aesthetic.

Image 2 Prompt: 
A realistic, eye-level portrait of a young woman with vibrant reddish-brown wavy hair, posing confidently in a fitness studio. She has one arm raised, revealing a natural, in-service physiques soft skin texture. She is dressed in a charcoal grey sports bra with mesh detailing and the "NYATHLETICS" logo, paired with beige drawstring utility trousers. Her expression is calm and neutral, looking directly at the camera. The scene is illuminated by warm, ambient overhead lights that reflect off her skin, with a shallow depth of field that softly blurs the mirrors and studio equipment in the background.

图片 1 提示：
一张高分辨率的抓拍中景照片，一位年轻女士，波浪状赤褐色头发，脸上略带雀斑，置身于暖色调的室内环境中。她低头，神情专注，正在调整浅卡其色工装裤的腰带。她身穿灰色混色运动上衣，带有黑色饰边和印有“NYATHLETICS”字样的下摆。灯光柔和且富有电影感，突显了自然的皮肤纹理和真实柔和的腹部。背景略微模糊，展示了一个现代室内空间，米色墙壁柔和，隐约可见一个空调设备，营造出一种真实、未经修饰的生活美学。

图片 2 提示：
一张逼真的平视肖像，一位年轻女士，拥有充满活力的红棕色波浪发，自信地在健身房中摆姿势。她抬起一只手臂，展现出自然、健美的柔软皮肤纹理。她身穿炭灰色运动文胸，带有网眼细节和“NYATHLETICS”标志，搭配米色抽绳工装裤。她表情平静而中性，直视镜头。场景由温暖的、环境化的顶灯照亮，光线反射在她的皮肤上，景深较浅，柔和地模糊了背景中的镜子和健身器材。

prompts.title: 樱花太空殖民地插画提示
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于生成一个樱花盛开的太空殖民地内部插图，经确认可与 Nano Banana 2、Imagen 4 和 Grok 配合使用。
prompts.content: High-definition, high-resolution 2.5D rendered illustration. A massive, horizontally tilted cylindrical space with a diameter of 6400 meters. The inner wall alternates between sections of green space and urban areas, and sections of glass and frames. The cherry blossoms are in full bloom in the green space, and their petals are falling. Beyond the glass, outer space is visible. White clouds drift along the inner surface of the cylinder. The innermost part of the cylinder is blocked off by a huge metal bulkhead, which is obscured by air. The distant areas appear blue and hazy due to atmospheric perspective. The image is taken from a camera angle slightly looking down toward the end of the cylinder from near its central axis.
prompts.translatedContent: 高清、高分辨率的 2.5D 渲染插画。一个巨大的、水平倾斜的圆柱形空间，直径 6400 米。内壁交替呈现绿地和城市区域，以及玻璃和框架区域。绿地中樱花盛开，花瓣飘落。透过玻璃，可以看到外太空。白云沿着圆柱体的内表面漂浮。圆柱体最内部被一个巨大的金属舱壁挡住，舱壁被空气遮蔽。由于大气透视，远处的区域呈现蓝色和朦胧。图像是从靠近圆柱体中心轴的位置，稍微向下看向圆柱体末端的摄像机角度拍摄的。

prompts.title: 空灵电影感时尚肖像提示
prompts.description: 为 Gemini Nano Banana Pro 提供的详细提示，用于生成一张电影级的竖版时尚编辑肖像（9:16），描绘一位长发飘逸的黑发女性，身着飘渺的高级定制礼服。图像中有一个透明的水晶球，内含一个微型发光宇宙，背景是柔和的宇宙渐变色，光线超现实且梦幻。
prompts.content:
A cinematic vertical fashion editorial portrait (9:16) of a beautiful woman with long, airy black hair, softly wavy and floating weightlessly as if suspended in a gentle breeze.
She wears an ethereal haute couture gown in soft ivory, pale champagne, and luminous pearl tones. The fabric is light and translucent layered chiffon, silk, and organza that float and diffuse light beautifully. 

Her face is softly lit in full clarity — glowing skin, delicate features, serene expression, soft radiant makeup with a dewy finish.
She gently holds a transparent crystal sphere near her heart.
Inside the sphere: a luminous miniature universe — pastel nebula clouds, glowing stardust, soft galaxies, dreamy gradients, and faint distant lights. The internal world is soft and magical with gentle refraction.

 A subtle inverted silhouette of her appears within, blending harmoniously with the glowing cosmos.
Background: soft cosmic gradient in pale blues, lavender, and silver tones, filled with diffused glowing stars and dreamy haze.
Lighting: soft diffused lighting, glowing highlights, gentle bloom effect, subtle backlight creating a halo-like aura.
Ultra-realistic, soft contrast, dreamy cinematic depth, 8k resolution.
Mood: ethereal, soft, celestial, poetic, dreamlike elegance.
prompts.translatedContent:
一幅电影般的竖版时尚肖像 (9:16)，描绘了一位美丽的女性，她拥有一头飘逸的黑色长发，发丝柔软卷曲，轻盈地漂浮着，仿佛悬浮在微风中。
她身着一袭空灵的高级定制礼服，颜色是柔和的象牙色、淡香槟色和璀璨的珍珠色。面料轻盈半透明，由多层雪纺、丝绸和欧根纱构成，随风飘动，完美地散射着光线。

她的脸庞被柔和的光线完全照亮——肌肤焕发光泽，五官精致，神情宁静，妆容柔和而富有光泽，呈现出水润的质感。
她将一个透明的水晶球轻轻地捧在心口。
水晶球内部：一个发光的微缩宇宙——柔和的星云、闪烁的星尘、朦胧的星系、梦幻般的渐变色彩和微弱的远方光芒。这个内在世界柔和而充满魔幻色彩，伴随着轻柔的折射效果。

她的一个微妙的倒影出现在水晶球内，与发光的宇宙和谐地融为一体。
背景：柔和的宇宙渐变色调，以淡蓝色、薰衣草色和银色为主，充满弥漫的闪烁星光和梦幻般的薄雾。
光线：柔和的漫射光，发光的高光，轻柔的泛光效果，微妙的背光营造出光环般的氛围。
超现实主义，柔和对比，梦幻般的电影景深，8k 分辨率。
氛围：空灵、柔和、天体、诗意、梦幻般的优雅。
